name: Skyborne
summary: In Skywall, the Skyborne face a failing refuge and the loss of those who once guarded it. Their ancestors, high elves descended from night elves, fled Eldre'Thalas after resisting Prince Tortheldrin's demonic pacts. A bargain with wind spirits carried them to Zephras Isle, but now the spirits are gone and the island is breaking apart.

sections.title: Flight from Eldre'Thalas
sections.body:
After the Sundering, the Shen'dralar of Eldre'Thalas struggled without the Well of Eternity. Prince Tortheldrin sought salvation by summoning the demon Immol'thar and draining its power. Nobles and citizens feared another Legion invasion, so they resisted. Tortheldrin answered with a purge that killed dozens of houses.

Survivors rallied behind a masked figure called the Shal'nan, or the Veiled One. A desperate raid on Tortheldrin's ritual sanctum unleashed chaotic magic. The Shal'nan gathered the survivors and led them west to the port of Eldre'narr. They took to the sea as the Prince's fleet pursued them.

sections.title: Sanctuary in the Sky
sections.body:
At sea, the exiles found themselves cornered, so they made a pact with primordial wind spirits. The spirits lifted Zephras Isle into the sky and anchored it in Skywall, the Elemental Plane of Air. During the Shrine of the Four Winds' consecration, the Shal'nan gave up absolute rule and entrusted governance to an elected council.

Over millennia in this strange realm, the night elf exiles became fair, slender high elves. In recent generations, more children have been born with pale blue skin through the Sky-Touched Blessing.

sections.title: A Shattering Calm
sections.body:
For centuries, the Skyborne lived in isolation. The wind spirits forbade them to speak of the Windlord, Al'Akir, and questions about him met only eerie unease. Then, a few centuries ago, the spirits vanished without explanation, and the Shal'nan disappeared with them.

Without their caretakers, the arcane pylons holding Zephras Isle aloft began to fail. Outlying landmasses broke away, refugees crowded the remaining isle, and desperation gave rise to bandits and the Al'Aketh, a fanatical cult devoted to Al'Akir. Now the High Order seeks salvation by reclaiming ancestral arcane magic, while the Windshapers hold to elemental rites.

faq.answer: The skyborne, or shen'dorei, are high elves descended from ancient night elves who rebelled against Prince Tortheldrin in Eldre'Thalas. Their name means the hidden people. To escape his vengeful fleet, they struck a pact with wind spirits, who carried their island, Zephras Isle, into Skywall, the Elemental Plane of Air.

faq.q: Why do some Skyborne have blue skin?
faq.answer: Millennia in the Elemental Plane of Air changed the Skyborne. Through the Sky-Touched Blessing, roughly three out of ten children are now born with blue skin. Scholars predict their ancestral night elf traits will soon be entirely supplanted.

The Shal'nan, or the Veiled One, was the masked leader of the resistance against Prince Tortheldrin's demon summoning in Eldre'Thalas. After leading survivors to safety in Skywall, the Shal'nan surrendered absolute rule for an elected council and served the Skyborne until disappearing centuries ago with their elemental benefactors.

faq.q: What is happening to Zephras Isle?
faq.answer: Zephras Isle remains aloft in Skywall on magical pylons attuned to elemental power. After the wind spirits who maintained them vanished centuries ago, the pylons began to fail. Parts of the isle broke away into the void, stranding survivors and driving displaced elves to banditry.

faq.q: What are the High Order and the Windshapers?
faq.answer: The High Order and the Windshapers are the Skyborne's two main cultural factions. The High Order descends from Highborne magisters and seeks to rebuild society through disciplined arcane mastery. The Windshapers trace their roots to ordinary night elf citizens and honor the elemental and spiritual customs they developed in Skywall.

The Al'Aketh are Skyborne who worship Al'Akir the Windlord. Their ancestors' elemental benefactors feared and avoided speaking of Al'Akir. After Zephras Isle began to collapse, homeless and disenfranchised refugees turned to him for salvation and power.

angles.text: As a night elf, you share bloodlines with the ancient Shen'dralar and northern night elves. Millennia in Skywall changed the Skyborne into high elves, and more of their children are now born with elemental blue skin.
Among the Skyborne, the High Order preserves ancient Highborne spellcraft carried out of Eldre'Thalas. Its members seek to save their crumbling island through rigorous arcane mastery.

Among the Skyborne, the Windshapers follow an elven lineage closely tied to Skywall's wind spirits. They rely on communion with the elements rather than the arcane traditions of their Highborne forebears.
